Name: Clint Sells Solid Gold Lewis
Author: bezajel
Description:
[center][size=4]The secret is out. Lewis' misappropriation of town funds has been revealed. But his taste was never in question! You've got a private fortune on hand to fund the arts, and Clint has kept the mold for his aptly named masterpiece: Solid Gold Lewis.[/size][/center]
[center][/center]
[center][size=3][color=#D4D4D8][img]https://i.postimg.cc/kMLcHrGD/Lewis-export.png[/img][/color][/size][/center]

[size=4][b]Installation instructions[/b][/size]
[color=#d4d4d8]Simply unzip and place in your Mods folder.  [/color][color=#d4d4d8][size=2]Requires Content Patcher.[/size][/color]

[size=4][b]Features[/b][/size]

[b][img]https://i.postimg.cc/5ytcy6TR/smallclint.png[/img] Purchase the Solid Gold Lewis statue from Clint's Blacksmith shop.[/b]

[b][img]https://i.postimg.cc/5ytcy6TR/smallclint.png[/img] Buy as many copies as you like - [size=2]Use alongside [/size][url=https://www.nexusmods.com/stardewvalley/mods/43058][size=2]Solid Gold Villager Statues[/size][/url] for alternative textures[size=2].[/size][/b]

[b][img]https://i.postimg.cc/5ytcy6TR/smallclint.png[/img] Configuration options to suit multiple gameplay styles.[/b]


[b][size=4]Configuration[/size][/b]
GMCM recommended.

[u]Unlock Conditions[/u]
[list]
[*][b]Immersive[/b] ([i]default[/i]): statue is unlocked for sale once you have found the original (Clint waits 'til the secret's out).[/*]
[*][b]Unconditional[/b]: statue is unlocked from day 1.[/*]
[/list][u]Daily Limit[/u]
[list]
[*]Set or remove the daily purchase limit (per player). [i]Default: 1[/i][/*]
[/list][u]Gold Price[/u]
[list]
[*]Set the statue's price, options from 0 - 1,000,000 gold. [i]Default: 10,000[/i][/*]
[/list][u]Gold Bars Required[/u]
[list]
[*]Set the number of gold bars required, options from 0 - 1,000. [i]Default: 10[/i][/*]
[/list][line]
[size=2]Feel free to comment if you think more configuration options are required, or if you know a way to force a wait time like a tool upgrade.[/size]


[size=4][b]Shout outs[/b][/size]
[color=#d4d4d8]Shout out to [url=https://www.nexusmods.com/profile/Kittykaysue]Kittykaysue[/url] whose very first mod [url=https://www.nexusmods.com/stardewvalley/mods/43058]Solid Gold Villager Statues[/url] inspired this one. Their AT mod includes 28 Solid Gold Villagers, and it would be a shame to limit yourself to only 1 per save. This is the mod shown in my screenshots.[/color]
